## Standing operator rules
- "separate from the main session goal, please also run the procedure 'enterprise-tenant-onboarding' in between your other work. Goal: Onboard Acme Industries as an enterprise tenant with a provisioned database, seeded account, welcome email, and one-time setup-fee invoice. Run these steps in order, one at a time:"
- "Goal for this session: split the monolithic ledgerly/api/routes.py into per-resource routers."
- "please keep commits small so review stays easy."
- "Never enable a new Celery task in `ledgerly/tasks/` unless `perf/locust_tasks.py` demonstrates at least 400 successful task executions per second with zero timeout failures."
- "Note that sandbox payments moved to https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev; sbx-pay-a is shut down and returns stale fixtures. Use sbx-pay-c."
- "Never modify the license text or attribution section in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md by hand."
- "Pause the router split. Higher priority: the dunning email scheduler in ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py sends reminders to customers who already paid. Fix that."

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Acme Industries; org `org_acme_industries`; request `REQ-2025-01842`; plan `enterprise-annual`; currency `USD`.
- Customer `cus_acme_2025`; migration `0042`; seed `./seeds/acme-enterprise-v3.json`; conflict key `external_id`.
- Sandbox: `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `https://sbx-pay-a.ledgerly.dev` is superseded and must not be used.
- Request context: `current_request_id`; invoice page size: 25.
- Rounding: `billing/currency.py`; tests: `tests/test_currency_rounding.py`.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Pool size 50: caused staging lock contention and deadlocks.
- Wildcard repository imports: obscure missing names.
- `count()` plus `limit().offset()`: causes legacy-pagination warnings; use a counted subquery beneath an outer `select()`.
- `print()`: lacks logging context; use structured logging.
- `Depends(get_session)` defaults: trigger Ruff B008; use `Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)]`.

## Plan and progress
- Onboarding steps 1–5 done: validation, organization creation, database migration, seeding, and billing customer creation.
- Steps 6–8: status unknown; no commands issued. Exact next command was not supplied.
- Router split: paused/pending.
- Dunning-paid-customer bug: pending; no command issued, status unknown.
- Celery gate: pending if applicable; load-test command unspecified.
- Keep commits small.

## Recent work
- Organization created, database migrated to `0042`, seed applied, and customer `cus_acme_2025` created successfully.
- Scheduler DST regression coverage was added; scheduler/billing tests passed, and Ruff passed.
- Full suite: 186 passed, 2 skipped, 1 unrelated legacy-invoice-rounding failure.
- Added six currency-rounding regression cases; all passed, with 91% coverage of `billing/currency.py`.
